text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi-Jordanian joint trade commission to hold meeting in Baghdad at the beginning of next month.
- Libya is ready to bring foodstuffs to Iraq and transport Iraqi oil to world markets.
- Saddam congratulates Iraqi Christians on Christmas.
- Iraqi establishments continue celebrations because of the recovery of Saddam's eldest son Uday.
- Iraqi Oil Minister starts official visit to Turkey.
(The above stories were carried by IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Russia is ready to repair Iraq's power stations.
